name: Team Squirtle: Aerial Dominance & Intimidate Breaker
archetype: Flying STAB pressure, Intimidate attack reduction, and 4x fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Kurt's 5v5 Gym battle prompts the player to select 5 active team members: Arbok/Primeape acts as the primary frontline breaker, cutting Kurt's physical Attack on entry with Intimidate and crushing Blissey/Shuckle through its catastrophic 4x Fighting weakness with STAB Close Combat; Blastoise/Fearow brings Flying STAB Drill Peck to destroy Bug hybrids and provides Ground immunity; Alakazam/Weezing bypasses high physical Defense using STAB Psychic; Jolteon/Sandslash shocks Slowbro/Scizor with Discharge; and Snorlax anchors the party with colossal HP and Rest longevity.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid. STAB Drill Peck provides devastating super-effective Flying coverage against Kurt's Bug fusions. Roost provides reliable recovery.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate grants Ground immunity, while STAB Psychic cleanly dismantles Beedrill/Ariados.
486 BST speed sweeper. Volt Absorb absorbs Electric moves. Discharge electrocutes Slowbro/Scizor and paralyzes Lotad/Kingdra.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Kurt's physical Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat delivers massive 4x damage to crush Blissey/Shuckle.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Dragon Pulses and special moves comfortably, resetting any damage or status with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Shrugs off Water attacks with Water Absorb and provides consistent bulky support across Slowpoke Well and Route 33.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
